pageSubtitle: Metrics 3–7 — Revenue, Gross Profit, High Margin Penetration, Repeat Order Rate, Customer Expansion

m3.sectionLabel: M3 · Average Revenue per Existing Customer
m3.tooltipInfo: If the Avg line is far above Median, a few large customers are pushing the average up — not even growth. The orange bar + ⚠ marks a month where 1 customer contributed > 25% of total revenue. "High Margin Contribution" in the month detail measures the REVENUE share from High Margin products — different from M5, which measures the CUSTOMER share who bought them.
m3.chartTitle: Total Revenue Existing vs Avg & Median Revenue per Customer (12 Months)
m3.chartSubtitle: Bar = Total Revenue · Solid line = Avg · Dashed line = Median · ⚠ = top customer > 25% · Click a bar for per-customer detail
m3.emptyMessage: No revenue data for this month

m4.heroTitle: Total Gross Profit from Existing Customers
m4.pageSubtitle: KPI 4 — Average Gross Profit. Gross profit contribution per existing customer, split by tier (Top/Mid/Bottom).
m4.sectionLabel: M4 · Average Gross Profit per Existing Customer
m4.tooltipInfo: Same as M3, but based on Gross Profit (absolute margin), not Revenue. Tiers are recalculated each month from the median individual GP — the customer mix per tier can differ from M3 even if the chart shape looks similar.
m4.chartTitle: Total GP Existing Customer — Contribution per Tier (12 Months)
m4.chartSubtitle: Tier determined each month: Top = GP > median · Mid = 50%–100% median · Bottom = < 50% median · ⚠ = top GP customer > 25%
m4.periodChartTitle: Breakdown Chart — Gross Profit Contribution per Tier
m4.periodChartSubtitle: Gross Profit breakdown (Rp) by customer tier this period
m4.trendChartTitle: 12-Month Trend Chart — Stacked Gross Profit (3 Tiers)
m4.trendChartSubtitle: Gross Profit trend per tier over the last 12 rolling windows
m4.pageDescription: Accumulated Gross Profit from existing customers who transacted within the active window, grouped into 3 profit contributor tiers: Top, Mid, and Bottom.
m4.tableTitle: Gross Profit Contribution Detail per Customer
m4.tableSubtitle: List of Gross Profit contributors and tier classification within the active window

m5.pageSubtitle: KPI 5 — High Margin Penetration. Share of existing customers who bought high margin products this month.
m5.sectionLabel: M5 · High Margin Product Penetration — Current Month
m5.tooltipInfo: Penetration measures the CUSTOMER share (not revenue) who bought at least 1 product tagged High Margin by an admin (Settings → High Margin). Different from Contribution (trend chart above), which measures the REVENUE share — many customers buying (high Penetration) doesn't mean the value is large (Contribution can still be low), or vice versa.
m5.trendChartTitle: High Margin Contribution vs Penetration — 12 Month Trend
m5.trendChartSubtitle: Contribution = % revenue from high margin products · Penetration = % customers who bought high margin products
m5.distChartTitle: Monthly Chart — Revenue vs High Margin Revenue
m5.distChartSubtitle: Total revenue vs high margin product revenue in this period
m5.chartSubtitle: Click chart to view customer list — current month snapshot
m5.emptyMessage: No existing customer bought high margin products this month

m6.sectionLabel: M6 · Repeat Order Rate — Current Month
m6.tooltipInfo: "Repeat order" here means MORE THAN 1 transaction within the current month — not just having bought before. The green target line is configured in Settings → Threshold, not always 100%.
m6.trendChartSubtitle: Share of existing customers transacting more than once within the current month
m6.chartSubtitle: Green ≥ {{thresholdPct}}% (on target) · Click to view customer list
m6.emptyMessage: No existing customer ordered more than once this month

m7.pageDescription: Share of existing customers with rising spending vs flat/declining this period.
m7.pageSubtitle: KPI 7 — Customer Expansion Rate. Share of existing customers with rising spending vs flat/declining this period.
m7.sectionLabel: M7 · Customer Expansion Rate — Spending Up vs Flat/Down
m7.tooltipInfo: Compared against the 30 days BEFORE the active period (not the same month last year). A customer who didn't order at all before but orders now still counts as "spending up".
m7.chartTitle: Customer Expansion Rate — 100% Stacked Horizontal (12 Months)
m7.chartSubtitle: Each row = 1 month · Green = % spending up vs prior 30 days · Grey = % flat/down · Click a bar for per-customer detail
m7.distChartTitle: Current Period Chart — Spend Change Status Distribution
m7.distChartSubtitle: Number of customers by spend growth status
m7.emptyMessage: No expansion data for this month
